newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Belle Corp FRN increased to US$150 mln.
newsitem.headline: Belle Corp FRN increased to US$150 mln.

text.p: Belle Corp's floating rate note issue due 2002 has been increased to US$150 million from US$100 million due to oversubscription, the lead managers said on Wednesday.
The five-year notes were issued at par to float at 180 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 200 basis points.
Lead managers are Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Hanwha Merchant Bank.
Co-lead managers are BT Asia, Coryo Merchant Bank and Nikko Securities Co (Asia).

Senior managers are Banque Nationale de Paris Hong Kong, Asian Banking Corp, CARIPLO Singapore, Dong Ah Securities Co, HanGil Merchant Banking Corp, Kyongnam Bank, Shinhan Investment Bank and Kwangju Bank.

Managers are Bear Stearns Asia, Hanmi Leasing and Finance (HK), Nara Banking Corp, Samsam Merchant Bank, Tong Yang Merchant Bank, Yeungnam Merchant Banking Corp, Chungbu Leasing & Finance (HK), Korea Leasing (Hong Kong), Leasing & Finance of Pusan Co and Ta Chong Bank.
Signing is set for April 4. The payment date is April 10.
